correctness.rationale: Derived clique update from s=c+p and degree a+b-1: if total even and s=(a+b)/2 the entire clique complements, otherwise becomes constant; independent word becomes 0,I,1 according to 2c<a,=a,>a. Thus any state reaches a corner or two-cycle by time 2, and a>b corners collapse in one more step. Enumerating central line 1<=p<=b-1 excluding c=a/2 yields exact three-round phase iff a>b, even a+b, b>=3; Vandermonde subtraction gives E3=C(a+b,r)-2C(a,r)-1_{a even} C(a,a/2)C(b,b/2). Recurrent corners, central ties, and endpoints give R=2+2*1_{a<=b}+2*1_{a>b,even total}C(a,r)+1_{a,b even}C(a,a/2)C(b,b/2). Independent exhaustive direct graph updates for every a,b in [1,6] with a+b<=9 confirmed each relevant formula. Central binomial asymptotics give P(T=3)~sqrt(2/(pi(a+b))) as b grows, a>b. The finite check is corroboration, not the proof.
